snippet.title: Embark on a pixel adventure of Sword and Magic!
snippet.description: Emond Continent is shrouded in chaos and unrest. As the "Executor" inheriting the will of the Goddess, you bear the mission of preventing the awakening of the Demon Lord and saving the magical world! In this world where heroes of different races coexist, build a party with your friends and together defeat evil!
